mentions.name: wadec
mentions.description: A WebAssembly binary decoder (parser for .wasm files) written from scratch in Rust, built as a way to learn both WebAssembly and Rust. It has reached v3 spec conformance by running the upstream spec test suite. It is intentionally not a highly performant production decoder and offers no streaming API; instead it targets educational use and debugging of WebAssembly modules, with a focus on good error messages, code documentation, and readability.
mentions.audience: People using it for educational purposes and developers debugging issues with WebAssembly modules
mentions.source_excerpt:
As a means to learn about both WebAssembly and Rust, I started writing a WebAssembly binary decoder (i.e. a parser for `.wasm` files) from scratch.

Recently it hit v3 spec conformance. (I'm executing the upstream spec test suite.)

I don't plan to make it a highly-performant decoder for use in production environments, but rather one that can be used for educational purposes, easy to read and/or debugging issues with modules.
